messages.subject: Climate & Sustainability Executive | ESG, External Affairs & Country Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Victoria,

Ruston McQueen's global executive-search work across climate, sustainability, energy transition and impact leadership is closely aligned with my background. I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, with responsibility across government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications. I am pursuing Director, VP, Country and Regional mandates where climate and responsible-growth strategy depends on credible institutional engagement and operational delivery. Saudi Arabia and the UAE are priority markets, with broader international mobility.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
